acquisition_method: The 20 most intense peptide ions were fragmented in the HCD collision cell and analyzed in the linear ion trap
cleavage_agent: Overnight on-bead digestion of affinity-purified (AP) complexes was performed using 500 ng trypsin
collision_energy: a normalized collision energy at 30 V
fragmentation_method: The 20 most intense peptide ions were fragmented in the HCD collision cell
ionization_type: The HPLC system was coupled to Orbitrap Fusion mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) through a Nanospray Flex Ion Source
labeling: inferred: Precursor intensity-based protein quantification was done essentially as described in earlier publications by calculating iBAQ (intensity-Based Absolute Quantification) values
mass_analyzer: Full scan MS survey spectra (m/z 360–1550) in profile mode were acquired in the Orbitrap
reduction_concentration: Mitochondrial pellets were mixed with the appropriate amount of buffer to obtain a homogenate containing at the final concentration ∼10 mg/ml total proteins, 20 or 100 mM KCl, 20 mM MgCl2, 2.5 mM DTT
reduction_reagent: Mitochondrial pellets were mixed with the appropriate amount of buffer to obtain a homogenate containing at the final concentration ∼10 mg/ml total proteins, 20 or 100 mM KCl, 20 mM MgCl2, 2.5 mM DTT

instrument.evidence: The HPLC system was coupled to Orbitrap Fusion mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
